settings.scroll-while-paused.label: Scroll while paused
settings.scroll-while-paused.description: Keep the media pill title scrolling while playback is paused. By default it scrolls only while playing.
settings.open-media-panel.label: Open full media panel on click
settings.open-media-panel.description: Open Noctalia's Media panel directly from the bottom pill. By default, the pill reveals the expanded island first; clicking its media content then opens the panel.
settings.panel-default-position.label: Use default panel position
settings.panel-default-position.descript: Open the Media panel at Noctalia's default location instead of attaching it below the expanded island.
